name: cursor_null_triggers_resync
invariant: INV-11 — a NULL/unknown cursor below the prune mark forces one resync
notes: A follower with no usable cursor sends `after = -1` (the NULL sentinel). When the hub has pruned past that point, the page must report `resync_required` and ship zero entries, so the follower takes one snapshot instead of replaying a journal with a hole in it.
